opciones: She follows the herd wherever it goes.
She jumps on every bandwagon she sees.

visual.pregunta: Upgrade the paragraph: “Many teenagers do the same as their friends. They don’t want to be different. But some teenagers are different and they are happy.”
visual.floja: Many teenagers do the same as their friends because they don’t want to be very different. But some teenagers are very different and they are very happy.
tachar: very different and they are very happy
visual.porque: Same ideas and simple vocabulary; “very” three times; no collocations or idioms.
puntos: Idiom with purpose: follow the herd
Idiom with purpose: march to the beat of their own drum
Collocations: reject mainstream values, express their individuality, develop self-esteem
Complex structures: subordinate clause and participle phrase
visual.clave: Collocations + two purposeful idioms + varied structures

visual.mal: I felt like a fish out of the water, and it was the last straw of the camel.
visual.bien: I felt like a fish out of water. Two or three exact, purposeful idioms beat ten forced ones.
